HFGCS / Emergency Action Messages (EAM).reason: Voice/ALE audio only; no licensed public text log or API. Public WebSDR/KiwiSDR automation is disallowed or impolite. Interception of communications is out of scope
HFGCS / Emergency Action Messages (EAM).user_action: If a clearly licensed public text log is published, review terms and add a metadata-only adapter

UVB-76.reason: Hobby shortwave audio monitoring only; no official machine-readable feed or reuse licence
UVB-76.user_action: None for automation; keep as a parked note

OpenWebRX.reason: Self-hosted SDR software, not a public feed
OpenWebRX.user_action: Install OpenWebRX on the Rogers Pi + SDR dongle; then add its local endpoint

sdr-list.xyz.reason: Web directory only, no documented API/terms for automated access
sdr-list.xyz.user_action: Ask the operator for an API or permission

SondeHub (Project Horus).reason: Data is CC BY-SA 2.0, but the official API wiki says do not regularly poll the HTTP APIs and points live users at MQTT/WebSockets
SondeHub (Project Horus).user_action: Do not add a scheduled poller; a future MQTT subscriber could be reviewed separately

Global Meteor Network.reason: CC BY 4.0 public REST API allows automated use; optional flag GEOSENTINEL_GMN (off by default) stores a station-count aggregate only, not trajectories
Global Meteor Network.user_action: Set GEOSENTINEL_GMN=1 to enable the aggregate layer

Reverse Beacon Network.reason: Real-time data is a telnet stream (needs a persistent worker); daily archives are multi-MB zips
Reverse Beacon Network.user_action: Approve a long-running worker (e.g., Render background worker) for the telnet feed

aprs.fi.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. ToS also forbids redistribution
aprs.fi.user_action: Get an aprs.fi key and accept no-redistribution (data could only be used privately)

FCC (ULS, maps).reason: fcc.gov bot-blocks automated clients (403); bulk ULS dumps are hundreds of MB
FCC (ULS, maps).user_action: Use FCC open data (integrated) or approve a worker for weekly ULS dumps

NTIA spectrum.user_action: Manually import the band plan once as a reference table

NSF SpectrumX.reason: Static research datasets, no live API
NSF SpectrumX.user_action: Download chosen datasets manually for ML training

Own-device Wi-Fi/Bluetooth band activity.reason: Optional flag GEOSENTINEL_WBAN (off by default) stores aggregate band counts and RSSI stats only from a user-owned Pi, Android/Termux, or OpenWrt router; MAC/SSID/BLE names are discarded and never hashed
Own-device Wi-Fi/Bluetooth band activity.user_action: Set GEOSENTINEL_WBAN=1 and GEOSENTINEL_WBAN_SOURCE to a local aggregate JSON produced by scripts/wban_collector.py

WiGLE.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. Low daily quota; no bulk scraping; non-commercial

OpenCelliD.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. (~5k req/day)
OpenCelliD.user_action: Create OpenCelliD token; attribute CC BY-SA

BeaconDB (MLS successor).reason: Lookup API needs submitted Wi-Fi/cell scans from your own device; no public read dataset
BeaconDB (MLS successor).user_action: Feed scans from your own Pi/phone

CellMapper.reason: Web only, account required, no API, no scraping

OpenSky Network.reason: Operational or automated use of the REST API, including in a live product, service, or internal automated system, requires a written license from OpenSky Network
OpenSky Network.user_action: Obtain a written license from contact@opensky-network.org, then add a licensed adapter

airplanes.live.reason: Unkeyed public API is closed (403); operators ask non-feeders to email contact@airplanes.live; access is limited to feeder IPs or paid sponsorship
airplanes.live.user_action: Email contact@airplanes.live or feed the network; do not scrape the map

ADS-B Exchange.reason: Paid RapidAPI or feeder-only Community API; acceptable-use / commercial use needs written permission
ADS-B Exchange.user_action: Run a feeder under their terms for a feeder key, or obtain a paid/written license; do not scrape

adsb.fi.reason: GitHub opendata terms limit use to personal, non-commercial access with citation (1 req/s); contact required for commercial or higher rates; public live-snapshot redistribution is not clearly allowed
adsb.fi.user_action: Leave parked unless adsb.fi explicitly permits public dashboard reuse

FlyItalyADSB.reason: Data is CC BY-SA 4.0 and a free tier allows commercial use, but a free API key (email) is required; not a keyless endpoint
FlyItalyADSB.user_action: Request a free key and add a keyed adapter if still in scope

FlightRadar24.reason: Official API is paid (no zero-cost machine-readable feed); website Basic tier is not an API and ToS forbid unlicensed reuse
FlightRadar24.user_action: Do not scrape; leave parked unless a paid license is approved

Liveuamap.reason: Official API is paid (from $150/mo); no free public feed
Liveuamap.user_action: Do not scrape the map; leave parked unless a paid license is approved

AISHub.reason: Requires an account and sharing your own AIS feed
AISHub.user_action: Set up an AIS receiver feed

AISStream.io.reason: Free AIS WebSocket requires a registered API key; not a keyless JSON poll and not clearly licensed for public snapshot redistribution
AISStream.io.user_action: Register a free key and review terms before adding a keyed, flag-off adapter

MarineCadastre AIS (NOAA/BOEM).reason: Heavy monthly/yearly bulk files (GB), not a live feed
MarineCadastre AIS (NOAA/BOEM).user_action: Approve an offline worker for ML training data

Space-Track.org.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. User agreement forbids redistribution
Space-Track.org.user_action: Create Space-Track account; data could feed ARGUS privately only

NOAA GOES imagery site.reason: Image products only (no data to ingest)
NOAA GOES imagery site.user_action: Dashboard can hotlink images; no action needed

N2YO.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter.
N2YO.user_action: Create N2YO key; CelesTrak (integrated) covers TLEs

NCEI space weather.reason: Archive landing page; data are bulk archives, no small live endpoint
NCEI space weather.user_action: Pick specific archive products for an offline worker

Blitzortung.reason: Data only for contributing station owners; non-commercial
Blitzortung.user_action: Build/host a Blitzortung station on the Pi

LightningMaps / Blitzortung raw data.reason: docs.lightningmaps.org and limaps.org terms: raw lightning data is only for contributing station owners or those with explicit permission; real-time maps and raw data may not be included on external sites
LightningMaps / Blitzortung raw data.user_action: None for automation; GOES GLM (integrated) covers lightning

NCEI CDO API.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. (CDO token)
NCEI CDO API.user_action: Request a free NCEI CDO token

Oklahoma Mesonet.reason: Terms restrict data use; some products licensed

Weather Underground PWS.reason: API only for station owners; commercial ToS forbids scraping
Weather Underground PWS.user_action: Own a PWS and use its owner key

PurpleAir.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. Points-based; no redistribution of raw data
PurpleAir.user_action: Create PurpleAir key; buy points if needed

AirNow API.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter.

AirNow.reason: Web maps only; data API needs key

INTERMAGNET.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0; written permission from the observatory institute is required for commercial use or bulk distribution to third parties (a public snapshot would redistribute the data)
INTERMAGNET.user_action: Get written permission from the observatory institute, or use USGS Geomagnetism (already integrated, public domain) for US stations such as FRD

SuperMAG.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. (SuperMAG username)

NOAA NCEI geomag models.reason: Calculator web service now requires a key
NOAA NCEI geomag models.user_action: Request NCEI geomag key (or bundle WMM coefficients locally)

NASA CDDIS.user_action: Create Earthdata login + approve a keyed adapter

EPA RadNet.reason: CSV downloads via a web form; no stable machine endpoint found
EPA RadNet.user_action: Identify a stable CSV URL, or download manually

EIA Open Data.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter.

FNET/GridEye (UTK).reason: Web views only, no public bulk API; research data on request

Southwest Power Pool.reason: Portal is a JS app; market-data terms need review before automated pulls
Southwest Power Pool.user_action: Review SPP market data terms, then approve a CSV adapter

MISO real-time data.reason: Legacy public API returns no data; new API needs registration; market-data terms

Grid Status.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter.

Cloudflare Radar.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. (API token)

CAIDA datasets.reason: Many datasets need a request/AUP agreement

Shadowserver.reason: Reports only for network owners; dashboard not an API

bgp.tools.user_action: Ask bgp.tools for bulk access; RIPEstat (integrated) covers BGP

Smithsonian GVP.user_action: Ask GVP for feed access; USGS HANS covers US volcanoes

RANDOM.ORG.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter.

Arkansas DEQ (ADEQ).user_action: Identify specific downloads to import manually

Tomsk Schumann resonance (sosrff.tsu.ru).reason: Server returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-03; image-only pages with no stated reuse licence
Tomsk Schumann resonance (sosrff.tsu.ru).user_action: Ask Tomsk State University SOS RFF for reuse permission

Tromso Geophysical Observatory magnetome.reason: flux.phys.uit.no data CGI needs a TGO user/password (anonymous query returns 'User error'); TGO data-use rules apply
Tromso Geophysical Observatory magnetome.user_action: Request TGO data access (contact listed on flux.phys.uit.no) and add a keyed adapter

HeartMath GCI magnetometers.reason: Live-data page now redirects to /gci/ marketing page; no public data endpoint or licence
HeartMath GCI magnetometers.user_action: None unless HeartMath publishes an open data feed

Stanford WALDO VLF archive.user_action: Create a WALDO account; data would need a keyed/manual import

Stanford SOLAR Center SID monitors.reason: SID station data is distributed via WALDO (account); site is education pages

Argo floats (Argovis).reason: Argovis API requires a free API key
Argo floats (Argovis).user_action: Get an Argovis key, or approve an ERDDAP GDAC adapter

IOOS ERDDAP.reason: erddap.ioos.us redirects (302) and serves per-dataset grids; the same ERDDAP protocol already runs in the erddap_oisst worker
IOOS ERDDAP.user_action: Name the IOOS datasets wanted; they can be added to the ERDDAP worker

Ocean Networks Canada.reason: Needs a free API key/account. Create one, add it as a GitHub Actions secret, and approve a keyed adapter. (Oceans 3.0 token)

MBARI MARS observatory.reason: No keyless live data API (public pages and archived sound only)

CDC FluView (Delphi epidata).reason: Delphi fluview endpoint retired for data after 2026-09-22
CDC FluView (Delphi epidata).user_action: Adopt the successor cast-api once its terms are reviewed; WHO FluNet covers US flu meanwhile
